name: iris_describe
description: Describe the Iris data set (resource ramen://demo/iris.csv): the row count and, for each of the four numeric columns (sepal_length, sepal_width, petal_length, petal_width), count, mean, std (sample standard deviation), min and max, rounded to 4 decimals. Computed with pandas from the CSV shipped with the group; pure, stateless, no arguments, no side effects. Use it first, before iris_outliers or iris_group_means, to get the real numbers instead of estimating them.
